label: Touchstone CM8200 DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem
description: DOCSIS 3.1 Touchstone modem with 2x192 MHz OFDM downstream and 2x96 MHz OFDMA upstream plus 32x8 SC-QAM fallback, bridged to two Gigabit Ethernet ports.
notes: Arris spec sheet: '32x8/2x2 DOCSIS 3.1 Cable Modem', 2x192 MHz OFDM downstream and 2x96 MHz OFDMA upstream, 32x8 SC-QAM at 108-1002 MHz, 'supports 2 Gigabit Ethernet ports for enhanced data throughput', up to 2.5 Gbps of broadband data. Operator-spec model (Cox Gigablast roll-out): no Wi-Fi, no voice ports on this variant.
